import json,subprocess,datetime,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
assert Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()=='903cfade-b93c-48fa-804e-379be1967313'
r=subprocess.run(['dtc','-I','dtb','-O','dts','/sys/firmware/fdt'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
lines=r.stdout.splitlines(); selected=[]
for i,line in enumerate(lines):
 if any(x in line for x in ('zyxclmm_drm','firmware-name','xlnx,zocl','fpga-full {')):
  selected.append({'line':i+1,'nearby':'\n'.join(lines[max(i-2,0):min(i+8,len(lines))])})
p=Path('/lib/firmware/xilinx/kv260-benchmark-b4096/kv260-benchmark-b4096.dtbo')
s=subprocess.run(['dtc','-I','dtb','-O','dts',str(p)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
print(json.dumps({'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'boot_id':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),'base_fdt':{'sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path('/sys/firmware/fdt').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'dtc_rc':r.returncode,'contains_zocl_node':any('zyxclmm_drm {' in x for x in lines),'contains_zocl_compatible':any('xlnx,zocl' in x for x in lines),'selected_lines':selected},'benchmark_dtbo':{'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'dtc_rc':s.returncode,'source':s.stdout},'board_mutations':False}))
